clips.title: The story
paras: In southern Duskwood, Zzarc'Vul wears an immense monocle. Its lens has the exact dimensions Viktori Prism'Antras needs for a stargazing telescope in Darkshire.

Zzarc'Vul, an ogre, wears a huge monocle tailored to his massive stature. When Viktori Prism'Antras of Darkshire began building a stargazing instrument from blueprints by the gnome engineer Cog, ordinary lenses proved too small. Zzarc'Vul's eyewear is the only polished glass in the region with the size and curve needed to focus light through the finished telescope.

The Vul'Gol Ogre Mound lies in the shadow of southern Duskwood, where Zzarc'Vul lives among his brute brethren. The brute shows little wish to give up his distinctive accessory. To claim the lens, you must defeat him on his own ground, then carry the glass back to Darkshire so Viktori can turn his gaze to the night skies.
